fields.Name: IT147 - Agent Execution Primitives and Multi-Step Loops (deterministic)
fields.Description: DETERMINISTIC tier (scripted native-tool-calling model, real SQL Server + ActionEngineServer + TaskGraphService + TaskGraphDispatcher). Verifies the single-channel JSON envelope bridge under native tool calling, sanitized native tool-name normalization (calculate_expression -> Calculate Expression), structured JSON Message coercion in Pipelines and loop steps, multi-step loop bodies (steps[] with steps.<id>.*, per-step condition, and outputMapping append) across in-turn ForEach/While and durable TaskGraph ForEach/While, agent-emitted nextStep.type='Tasks' parking in Paused and settling to Completed via TaskGraphDispatcher, and Flow graduation round-trip (ConvertTaskGraphToAgentSpec -> CompileFlowToTaskGraph -> TaskGraphService.Submit). Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: AEP1-AEP6 pass against SQL Server: Pipeline, in-turn multi-step ForEach/While, durable TaskGraph multi-step ForEach/While, agent-parked Tasks settlement, and Flow graduation round-trip all execute and clean up.
